song.title: Since Jesus Came Into My Heart
song.lyrics:
[V1] . G What a wonderful change in my life has been wrought . C G Since Jesus came into my heart I have light in my soul for which long I had sought . A7 D7 Since Jesus came into my heart
[C1] . G Since Jesus came into my heart . C G Since Jesus came into my heart Floods of joy o'er my soul Like the sea billows roll . C G D G Since Jesus came into my heart
[V2] . G I have ceased from my wandering and going astray . C G Since Jesus came into my heart And my sins, which were many, are all washed away . A7 D7 Since Jesus came into my heart
[V3] . G I'm possessed of a hope that is steadfast and sure . C G Since Jesus came into my heart And no dark clouds of doubt now my pathway obscure . A7 D7 Since Jesus came into my heart
[V4] . G There's a light in the valley of death now for me . C G Since Jesus came into my heart And the gates of the city beyond I can see . A7 D7 Since Jesus came into my heart
[V5] . G I shall go there to dwell in that city, I know . C G Since Jesus came into my heart And I'm happy, so happy, as onward I go . A7 D7 Since Jesus came into my heart
